Experience: Experience in Accounts or Audit; minimum 3 years experience of working in Animal Shelter Age limit: Maximum 45 years Age relaxation: Relaxable | Other conditions: | Typing speed of 30 words per minute Knowledge of Konkani, Marathi and English Knowledge of TDS, Income tax, GST laws, computer operations and book keeping

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed Application Form given with the advertisement.
Affix a latest passport size photograph on the application.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates of qualification, birth certificate, 15 years Goa residence certificate and experience documents.
Put the application in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Accountant cum Clerk", DSPCA, South Goa District.
Hand it over to the Member Secretary, DSPCA, South Goa, Ground Floor, Old Collectorate, Opp. Municipal Garden, Margao, Goa on a working day during office hours.
The application must reach the office on or before 30-11-2026 during working hours.
important_instructions: Decision of the Chairperson DSPCA, South Goa shall be final and binding Chairperson reserves the right to accept and reject any or all applications Expected remuneration should be within Government Approved rates under the DSPCA - Animal Welfare and Rescue Scheme

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DSPCA South Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DSPCA South Goa Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed Application Form attached to the advertisement (page 3-4 of the PDF)) and send it to Member Secretary, DSPCA, South Goa, Ground Floor, Old Collectorate, Opp. Municipal Garden, Margao- Goa, by by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.answer: Yes. Typing speed of 30 words per minute. Knowledge of Konkani, Marathi and English. Knowledge of TDS, Income tax, GST laws, computer operations and book keeping.
